channelTitle: Scratchy throat at night? Grandma June's spoonful trick
hook: Throat feels scratchy right before bed? Grandma June reaches for this spoonful.
remedy: A classic old-fashioned home comfort: a spoonful of honey steeped with a clove. Grandmas kept this one for chilly nights when a scratchy throat would not quit.
steps: Drop one whole clove into a spoonful of honey
Let it sit for a few minutes to infuse
Slowly swallow the honey, then discard the clove
caution: Never give honey to infants under 1 year old
cta: Did your grandma have a spoonful trick like this? Tell Grandma June in the comments
